attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.
geometry: Source polygons retained whole, no clipping/repair/deduplication; Z ignored for footprint, holes retained. Rendering a source mass is not identifying a unique physical building. Invalid source geometries are omitted and their snapshot IDs listed; no repair is applied.
height: AVG_HEIGHT metres, retained without fallback. Workbook describes maximum average footprint height; source HEIGHT_SRC retained. Extruded on flat local y=0; no terrain/elevation accuracy claimed.
height_rule: Require finite source AVG_HEIGHT > 0 and < 600 metres; exclude unsupported records, never replace their height.
id_semantics: Snapshot-qualified zero-based DBF record index. Archive has no OBJECTID field despite workbook description. Not a stable City building/parcel identifier.

license_evidence.decision: Use the explicit dataset-page licence link and dataset-specific notes as the affirmative grant; retain the inconsistent CKAN tag as a metadata defect, not a separate restriction. No confirmation from City staff obtained.
license_evidence.package_notes_excerpt: Further to the Open Government Licence

limitations: Illustrative use; verify independently for legal or official purposes.
2025 archive includes earlier measurements (LiDAR-derived fields reference 2015).
No MPAC assessment/ownership data, third-party imagery or pedestrian assets included.
output_crs: GeoJSON longitude/latitude, inverse spherical Mercator using radius 6378137 m
selection: Whole polygons fully covered by bbox; boundary intersections excluded, no clipping.
small_geometry_rule: Omit entire source record if any ring has area below 0.011 square metres in the local metric approximation; no sliver repair.
source_crs: WGS_1984_Web_Mercator_Auxiliary_Sphere (EPSG:3857 equivalent), verified from .prj; not geographic degrees
